run_StableDiffusionXLDenoiseStep: run the denoise step that iteratively denoises latents for text2img and img2img tasks
run_StableDiffusionXLControlNetDenoiseSt: run the denoise step with controlnet for text2img and img2img tasks
run_StableDiffusionXLInpaintDenoiseStep: run the denoise step for inpainting tasks with mask and masked image latents
run_StableDiffusionXLInpaintControlNetDe: run the denoise step with controlnet for inpainting tasks
